name: io.github.ChatPush/mcp-chatpush
title: ChatPush
description: Send WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS and MAX messages, files and bulk mailings via ChatPush

environmentVariables.name: CHATPUSH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token from the ChatPush dashboard (https://chatpush.ru)

environmentVariables.name: CHATPUSH_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API host. Change only for a white-label ChatPush installation.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <ChatPush API token from the dashboard>
